features.title: Advantages
features.textCard1: Create tournament grids in seconds using optimized algorithms.
features.textCard2: Full control over the appearance of matches: styles, colors and structure for your project.
features.textCard3: Work with popular tournament formats and flexible adaptation to any rules.
features.textCard4: Easy connection and use in modern frontend projects.

quick-start.title: How to use
quick-start.textCard1: Download the library in any convenient way. The installation takes only a couple of seconds and does not require complicated configuration — just run one command in the terminal.
quick-start.textCard2: Connect the library to your project and use only the necessary modules. The flexible import system makes it easy to integrate it into existing code.
quick-start.textCard3: Generate the tournament grid automatically. The library will create rounds, matches, and finals by itself, saving you time and eliminating manual calculations.

about.title: About the project
about.text: I created this library because I was looking for ready-made solutions for generating tournament grids and could not find anything convenient for developers. Then I thought: 'Why not do it yourself?' Right now it's a project that I'm developing, fixing bugs and improving as users give feedback. The goal is to make the library simple, convenient and useful for anyone who wants to create tournaments quickly.

documentation.documentation-introduction-goal: Goal: The library helps developers quickly create and display tournament brackets without manual coding or complex logic.
documentation.documentation-introduction-main-features: Main features: Supports different tournament formats, customizable match designs, and easy integration with React, JS, and HTML.
documentation.documentation-introduction-for-whom: For whom: Perfect for frontend developers, creators of gaming and esports projects, as well as educational and pet projects.
documentation.documentation-introduction-next: What's next: In this documentation, you will find installation instructions, a quick start guide, usage examples, styling customization, and API references.

documentation.documentation-opportunities-title: The library provides the following features:
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title1: Tournament bracket display — visualization of matches, participants, and tournament rounds
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title2: Dynamic generation — automatic creation of tournament bracket structures based on the number of participants
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title3: Support for a large number of participants — the ability to generate tournaments of various sizes
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title4: Round management — passing a custom round structure through the rounds property
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title5: Appearance customization — changing colors, element sizes, and the styling of winners and losers
documentation.documentation-opportunities-title6: Flexible integration — use in React projects as a standalone component
documentation.documentation-integration-title: Tournaments-Bracket integrates easily with any web project using JavaScript, React, or HTML. This page shows basic examples of connecting and using the library.

documentation.documentation-partnership-title: Tournaments-Bracket is an open project. Anyone can help its development: fix bugs, add new features, or improve the documentation.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title2li1: Found a bug or issue? Create an issue in the repository.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title2li2: The more detailed the description, the faster we can fix it.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title3li1: Have an idea for a new feature? Submit it as a feature request.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title3li2: All suggestions are considered; the best ones are added to the project.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title4li1: Anyone can submit a PR with fixes or improvements.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title4li2: Before submitting, follow the code style and test your changes.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title5li1: Help with documentation and examples is highly valued.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title5li2: Even fixing typos helps the community.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title6li1: You don’t need to be an experienced developer.
documentation.documentation-partnership-title6li2: You can participate in simple ways: commenting, suggesting ideas, or reviewing examples.

about-page.title: About the project
about-page.text: I created this library because I couldn't find a convenient and high-quality solution for generating tournament grids. The goal of the project is to provide developers with a simple and flexible tool that can be easily integrated into any web project.
about-page.chapter2card2: Creators of gaming and esports projects
about-page.chapter3text: Tournaments-Bracket is an open project that develops together with the community. The source code is available to everyone, and anyone can see how the library works from the inside or use it in their projects.
about-page.chapter2card2text1: The library is easily integrated into existing projects and does not impose architecture. Suitable for React, JavaScript and HTML, it allows you to quickly add a tournament grid without unnecessary code and complicated settings.
about-page.chapter2card2text2: A convenient tool for visualizing matches, tournaments and competition stages. It is suitable for both small local tournaments and online projects with a large number of participants.
about-page.chapter2card2text3: A great option for learning and experimentation. The library is easy to understand, it is convenient to try different tournament formats and practice working with visual components.
about-page.chapter2card2text4: It allows you to quickly implement a working prototype without having to develop the logic of the tournament grid from scratch. It saves time at the start and gives you the opportunity to focus on the main functionality of the product.
about-page.about-me-title: A little bit about the developer
about-page.about-me-text1: Programming became a part of my life at the age of 12. What started as an ordinary interest eventually turned into a conscious path and a serious goal — to become a strong and professional developer.
about-page.about-me-text2: I constantly study modern technologies, work on my own projects and pay attention to the quality of the code, architecture and user convenience. I am currently focused on web development and strive to create not just websites, but thoughtful, technological and high-quality digital products.
about-page.about-me-text3: I'm also interested in 3D modeling - it's important to me that projects are not only functional, but also visually expressive.
